facts.fact: The ICT strategy 2012-2017 plans a national network of 20 technology parks and an entrepreneurship support programme giving innovators space, laboratories and shared services with incubator companies and workshops for emerging companies, and says the Smart Village technology park has attracted investments.
facts.system: National ICT Strategy 2012-2017 technology parks and entrepreneurship support programme

note: as_of is the strategy's published month, 2013-02, as the passages give no event date; the passages give no tenants of Smart Village, so no park fact.
